title: [review] messaging.py:144: Auto-generated message IDs alw
description: The `candidate_next_id` value is computed but never assigned back to `self._next_id`. After processing a POST, `self._next_id` remains at its initial value of 1. Every subsequent POST without an explicit ID will receive id=1, causing the new message to silently overwrite the previous one in `_sent` dict (line 149). This results in data loss.
close_reason: Fixed: Added missing self._next_id = candidate_next_id assignment at line 145 in messaging.py. Auto-generated message IDs now properly increment after each POST.
